title: The Longest Walk in the Forest
statement:
A tree has `n` nodes and `n - 1` edges. The distance between two nodes is the number of edges on the path between them. Find the largest distance between any two nodes.

## Input
The first line contains `n`. Each of the next `n - 1` lines contains the two nodes joined by an edge.

## Output
Print the largest distance.

## Constraints
- `1 <= n <= 15000`
- The edges form a tree.
